SELECT c.id, c.name 
FROM customers c 
WHERE c.region = 'Norte' 
AND ( 
    SELECT MAX(o.amount) FROM orders o 
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.ordered_at IS NOT NULL 
) = (
    SELECT MAX(amount) 
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN ordered_at IS NOT NULL THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as amount 
        FROM orders 
        WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'Norte')
    ) t
);
